description: This Java source file defines the ReadOnlyHelperDAO class, which implements a read-only data access object for entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for retrieving entity data without modifying the database, emphasizing its read-only nature.

classes.name: ReadOnlyHelperDAO
classes.description: A DAO class providing read-only access to entity data within the OFBiz framework, implementing the GenericHelper interface.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Read-only method; always returns null, indicating creation is not supported.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a partial GenericValue entity by primary key, returning only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves multiple GenericValue entities by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Read-only method; always returns 0, indicating removal is not supported.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching specified conditions, returning an iterator.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds related entities through multiple relations.

methods.name: removeByCondition
methods.description: Read-only method; always returns 0, indicating removal is not supported.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Read-only method; always returns 0, indicating storage is not supported.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Read-only method; always returns 0, indicating storage is not supported.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Validates the data source, ensuring entity definitions are correct; does not add missing entities or fields.
